system_overview: chat-support-widget is a embeddable customer support chat widget with canned replies. It is built as a small focused system with Widget (embed.js) at its core, supported by Reply Router and Agent Console.

recommended_language.rationale: TypeScript fits the embeddable customer support chat widget with canned replies workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Widget (embed.js) as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The embeddable customer support chat widget with canned replies hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Agent Console asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Conversation, Message, Agent must persist relationally
Components: Widget (embed.js), Reply Router, Agent Console
